negative_controls.scope: Deliberately edited traces, not guest execution or new hardware-fault claims.

prior_regressions.scope: Generic I/O raw/optimized and eight I/O queue cases; shared-port collection, request ownership and cancellation
Signals/direct delivery, coalescing, Wait publication, NMI/context restoration, ring wrap/loss and callback retirement
Console/DOS/SIO last-client retirement, headless DOS and SIO, disabled builds, EXECOS.Write busy rejection and restored ROM console, unsafe FF93 with cleanup checkpoint and heap/ownership retained
Five-task real-media public example in both compiler modes and both sector sizes; 56 physical keys, text conversion, repeat/error/quit and screen/heap restoration

coverage: All eight public contexts simultaneously occupied: root console client, console worker, file-read client, filesystem worker, SIO worker, allocator/message producer, signal peer and message receiver; private idle additional

Raw and optimized bank 1 FASTEST125 on original 128/256 media with observer and identical-image/input replay; bank 3 raw/optimized functional 128-byte cases; STOCK810 128-byte optimized observation/replay

Each interaction has preset host/frame bounds; eight real matrix keys produce exactly eight specific collected read replies and observed glyphs; thirty 40-byte writes force wrapping and multi-quantum scrolling
Allocator clear/fill/free, message ownership/reply and signal handshakes progress during the single DOS.Read; exact media bytes and the full returned file payload checked independently
Zero RX deadline misses, TX refill misses and TX gaps; unchanged adapter command setup/hold and concurrent Forbid/CRITIC/post/next-sector/alarm/turnaround limits
Final retained cells plus glyph/cursor mapping equal all 960 screen bytes; normal shutdown restores screen/cursor/IRQ shadow, heap bank ownership and serial pointer retirement
Native change in this slice only exports two existing labels, adding no emitted instructions; observation uses existing CPU PCs rather than guest trace calls
Full pin/image/media/trace/input hashes retained; no compiler override or added successful-sector sleep
limitations: Initial full-screen console only; multiple independent windows and focus remain required separately specified work

Eight keyboard samples per timed case; reply/visibility numbers are observation bounds including scheduling and polling, not new hard real-time guarantees. Heavy scrolling can delay visible echo by about one second
The existing raw reader reaches 760 of 1024 stack bytes, leaving only 8 bytes above its untouched 256-byte interrupt reserve; more call depth requires fresh measurement
128-byte media has a 777-byte file, so the 70003-byte request ends with a short read; full 70003-byte payload exists only in the 256-byte fixture
Accurate disk mechanics enabled; throughput is for a single DOS.Read with concurrent work and is not wire bandwidth

Whole-residency and transaction-envelope masked maxima include idle_start SEI/WAI waiting intervals; WAI wakes on pending IRQ before CLI. They are not byte-service latency; all actual bytes retain their unchanged deadlines
No physical hardware, complete shell, DOS CON handler, application format/loader, key repeat or 12–16-task claim
Earlier target128-opt and target256-raw probes lack the later passive sector_end marker; conservative collection bounds are explicitly recorded rather than inferred as direct timestamps
